newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim America sets semi-annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim America sets semi-annual dividend.

text.p: Pilgrim America MagnaCap Fund class A set a semi-annual dividend on Friday as did the company's class B and class M shares.

The dividend for class A shares comprised of $0.0239 from net investment income and $4.912 from long-term capital gains. The dividend for class B and class M shares, which amounted to $4.912, was derived exclusively from long-term capital gains.
The dividend is payable January 22,1997 to shareholders of record December 31, 1996.

The previous semi-annual dividend for the class A shares, set at $0.0943, was payable August 20 1996. A similar date of payment was set for class M shares for its dividend of $0.0303. Class B shares had no previous dividend.
